description: Defines a template class 'stable_id_map' for managing objects with stable IDs, including iterators, insertion, deletion, and internal data structures. Also includes an intrusive linked list template 'stable_id_intrusive_list' for managing lists of stable_id_map elements.

classes.name: stable_id_map
classes.description: A container for objects with stable IDs, supporting insertion, deletion, and iteration.

classes.name: stable_id_intrusive_list
classes.description: A template class implementing an intrusive forward linked list of stable_id_map elements.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of objects stored.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the container is empty.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an object with a given stable ID exists.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Retrieves object by stable ID (non-const and const versions).

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Access object by stable ID (non-const and const versions).

methods.name: get_offset
methods.description: Returns internal offset of object with given ID.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs and inserts a new object with provided arguments, returning its stable ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts an object, returning its stable ID.

methods.name: erase (iterator version)
methods.description: Removes object pointed to by iterator.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all objects from the container.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves memory for specified number of objects.

methods.name: unsorted
methods.description: Returns span of all objects in storage.
